rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (2026 amounts)
rules.requirement: Berkeley owners who evict a tenant for an owner move-in must pay relocation assistance. For 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios de Berkeley que desalojen a un inquilino para mudarse ellos mismos deben pagar asistencia de reubicación. En 2026 el pago estándar es de $19,413, más $6,471 adicionales para los hogares que califiquen.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted for owner move-in; additional payment for qualifying households (criteria not stated in this document).
rules.effective_date_quote: Annual increases for owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments go into effect January 1, 2026.
rules.caveat: Amounts are indexed to inflation and adjusted every January 1 (1.5% CPI increase for 2026). Ordinance chapter citation is not stated in the document and is inferred.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 amounts)
rules.requirement: Berkeley owners who evict tenants to remove a property from the rental market must pay the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in. For 2026 that is $19,413 standard, plus $6,471 additional for qualifying households.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios de Berkeley que desalojen a inquilinos para retirar una propiedad del mercado de alquiler deben pagar la misma asistencia de reubicación que en una mudanza del propietario. En 2026 son $19,413, más $6,471 adicionales para los hogares que califiquen.
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act to withdraw the property from the rental market.
rules.effective_date_quote: Annual increases for owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments go into effect January 1, 2026.
rules.caveat: Amounts are indexed to inflation and adjusted every January 1. Ordinance chapter citation is not stated in the document and is inferred.
